description: Owner NFL betting policy: $75 fixed unit, whole 1U-5U positions, 5U maximum combined exposure for one correlated game thesis. Independent theses may be bet in the same game or across the slate without automatic per-game/slate caps. Independent analysis, live executable prices, fees, liquidity, current bankroll and position checks still apply.
rationale: The owner explicitly rejected per-slate and per-game caps as conflating unrelated bets with multiple exposures to one thesis. Remove both aggregate limits; preserve individual stake caps, mandatory correlation grouping, and all non-slate execution, bankroll and price safeguards. Correlated bets from the same thesis share a combined 5U budget.
notes: No fixed per-game or slate exposure cap: multiple independent, positively valued theses must not cannibalize each other's budget.
One game thesis or correlated driver has a 5U ($375) combined cap across tickets and runs. Every recommendation needs a correlation group.
The existing 3%-of-bankroll cap per position still applies if bankroll is available; any proposed amount below 1U after caps is rejected, never recommended as a fractional unit.
Staking evidence ladder, executable quote and depth, fees, and available-cash authorization remain unchanged.
All outstanding stakes are counted and reported; total exposure is observable even though no slate ceiling is imposed.
